# This test only checks that basic PATH lookups work.
# The full test of toolchain version selection is in gotoolchain.txt.

[GKOS:openbsd] skip 'broken on openbsd: #81173'

env TESTGO_VERSION=go1.21pre3

# Compile a fake toolchain to put in the path under various names.
env GKTOOLCHAIN=
mkdir $WORK/bin
go build -o $WORK/bin/go1.50.0$GKEXE ./fakego.gk  # adds .exe extension implicitly on Windows

[!GKOS:plan9] env PATH=$WORK/bin
[GKOS:plan9] env path=$WORK/bin

go version
stdout go1.21pre3

# GKTOOLCHAIN=go1.50.0
env GKTOOLCHAIN=go1.50.0
! go version
stderr 'running go1.50.0 from PATH'

# GKTOOLCHAIN=path with toolchain line
env GKTOOLCHAIN=local
go mod init m
go mod edit -toolchain=go1.50.0
grep go1.50.0 go.mod
env GKTOOLCHAIN=path
! go version
stderr 'running go1.50.0 from PATH'

# GKTOOLCHAIN=path with go line
env GKTOOLCHAIN=local
go mod edit -toolchain=none -go=1.50.0
grep 'go 1.50.0' go.mod
! grep toolchain go.mod
env GKTOOLCHAIN=path
! go version
stderr 'running go1.50.0 from PATH'

# GKTOOLCHAIN=auto with toolchain line
env GKTOOLCHAIN=local
go mod edit -toolchain=go1.50.0 -go=1.21
grep 'go 1.21$' go.mod
grep 'toolchain go1.50.0' go.mod
env GKTOOLCHAIN=auto
! go version
stderr 'running go1.50.0 from PATH'

# GKTOOLCHAIN=auto with go line
env GKTOOLCHAIN=local
go mod edit -toolchain=none -go=1.50.0
grep 'go 1.50.0$' go.mod
! grep toolchain go.mod
env GKTOOLCHAIN=auto
! go version
stderr 'running go1.50.0 from PATH'

# NewerToolchain should find Go 1.50.0.
env GKTOOLCHAIN=local
go mod edit -toolchain=none -go=1.21
grep 'go 1.21$' go.mod
! grep toolchain go.mod
env GKTOOLCHAIN=path
! go run rsc.io/fortune@v0.0.1
stderr 'running go1.50.0 from PATH'

-- fakego.gk --
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"strings"
)

func main() {
	var exe: string
	var name: string
	exe, _ = os.Executable()
	name = filepath.Base(exe)
	name = strings.TrimSuffix(name, ".exe")
	fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "running %s from PATH\n", name)
	os.Exit(1) // fail in case we are running this accidentally (like in "go mod edit")
}
